name: @sunnahlife/worker
description: Sunnah Life — BullMQ worker, hot-reload dev twin. The deployable entrypoint is apps/api's dist/worker.js (same codebase, compiled by `nest build`); this package exists for `bun --hot` development and mirrors src/main.ts → apps/api/src/worker.ts.

scripts.build: echo 'deployable worker = apps/api dist/worker.js (run `bun run build` there)' && exit 0

comments.deps: No dependencies of its own: imports are relative into ../api/src. For bun dev, run from apps/api (`bun --hot ../worker/src/main.ts` resolves through the api's node_modules), or set NODE_PATH=/home/z/my-project/apps/api/node_modules.
